summary: Retrieve tracks a user has liked, favorited, or reviewed
description: Returns the list of tracks a specific Jamendo user has liked, added to favorites, or reviewed. The `relation` parameter lets you filter by those actions. Results can be ordered by `rating_desc` (aggregated rating) or `updatedate_desc` (most recent interaction). Since Feb 2021 the field `audiodownload_allowed` indicates if the track may be downloaded, and as of Apr 2022 `audiodownload` will be empty when downloads are not allowed.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' still caps at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Ordering of results. Use 'rating_desc' for aggregated rating, 'updatedate_desc' for most recent interaction.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response header includes 'results_fullcount' (total rows without limit/offset). Use sparingly as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Jamendo user ID. Either `id` or `access_token` must be supplied.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user. Either `access_token` or `id` must be supplied.

parameters.name: track_type
parameters.description: Filter tracks by type. By default only album tracks are returned.

parameters.name: track_id
parameters.description: One or more track IDs to filter on.

parameters.name: artist_id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs to filter on.

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs to filter on.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the `audio` field. Default is mp31.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the `audiodownload` field. Defaults to the `audioformat` value, otherwise mp32.

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Filter by user interaction type. Multiple values act as OR (e.g., favorite+like). If omitted, all relations are considered.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request outcome (status, code, warnings, results count, etc.).

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of track objects matching the query.

notes: The `audiodownload_allowed` boolean indicates if the track can be downloaded; if false, the `audiodownload` field will be an empty string as of April 2022.
By default only `albumtrack` types are returned to avoid issues with legacy applications that expect album fields.
Both `client_id` and either `id` or `access_token` are required; `access_token` provides OAuth2 authentication, while `client_id` is an API key.
